description: The user's growth assistant: posts found in the last 3 days on their topics that still wait for a reply, each with a draft reply in their voice, plus the assistant settings. Free, read-only. Show each post briefly (author, post, link, draft) and help the user edit the draft; they post it from their own account. If there are no assistants, offer setup_growth_assistant.
name: get_growth_suggestions
title: Get today's posts to reply to
